final: WITH counts AS (SELECT c.nationality, COUNT(*) as record_count, SUM(cr.points) as total_points FROM constructors c LEFT JOIN constructorResults cr ON c.constructorId = cr.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality), avg_count AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) as avg_records FROM counts) SELECT counts.nationality, counts.record_count, counts.total_points, counts.record_count - avg_count.avg_records as difference_from_average FROM counts, avg_count ORDER BY counts.record_count DESC
